publicationStatement: Research candidate cluster only; not canonically publishable, installable, allocated or verified.

cases.input: A payroll account binding is imported as if the Person and identity anchor shared the account identifier.
cases.expect: Reject equality; preserve three linked identities.

cases.input: An operator retires WM-PER-002 before registry-owner alias confirmation.
cases.expect: Reject retirement and keep the reservation unresolved.

cases.input: A manager title automatically grants payroll write access.
cases.expect: Reject the inferred IAM role and grant.

cases.input: A package advertises Domain, Role, Assignment and Grant as one allocated aggregate type.
cases.expect: Reject the root claim; the offline cluster remains allocation-unresolved.

cases.input: Grant G has actions and scope but no live justification at effective time.
cases.expect: Reject activation of G.

cases.input: Child D adds delete and region B beyond source G.
cases.expect: Reject D for failed attenuation.

cases.input: A child grant is edited to widen scope after approval.
cases.expect: Reject mutation; require a separately justified root grant.

cases.input: Parent G is revoked while child D stays active; sibling S has an unrelated mandate.
cases.expect: Revoke D, preserve separately justified S.

cases.input: Delegation D points to itself and omits depth.
cases.expect: Reject the cycle and incomplete delegation metadata.

cases.input: Consent to disclose one record is used for general write access.
cases.expect: Reject operational capability beyond read/disclosure.

cases.input: Assignment A ends; G1 has only A, G2 has A plus live consent C.
cases.expect: Invalidate G1 and preserve G2 subject to review.

cases.input: Review R recommends revoke but no grant transition exists.
cases.expect: Keep grant state unchanged and record pending transition.

cases.input: A delegated reviewer receives the reviewed user's privileges.
cases.expect: Reject access creation from reviewer mandate.

cases.input: Metadata M contains an API secret and reversible encrypted password.
cases.expect: Reject M; retain only protected reference and safe metadata.

cases.input: An account authenticator record overwrites a WM-XCT-017 attestation.
cases.expect: Reject merge; preserve separate subjects and cross-reference.

cases.input: Credential status becomes revoked and system silently marks every grant revoked without cause links.
cases.expect: Reject conflation; record separate causal events.

cases.input: Cached token remains accepted after grant validity and propagation deadline.
cases.expect: Reject authorization and record propagation failure.

cases.input: Grant approval has no audit correlation and audit payload includes a secret.
cases.expect: Reject approval evidence and secret payload.

cases.input: A reporting projection is replayed as proof of authorization.
cases.expect: Reject authority inference from projection.

cases.input: A retired grant identifier is assigned to a new principal.
cases.expect: Reject identifier recycling.

cases.input: Role revision 3 mutates its action set in place while old assignments still cite revision 3.
cases.expect: Reject mutation; create successor revision and retain history.

cases.input: A condition cannot be evaluated and engine treats it as satisfied; parent purpose is absent and child invents one.
cases.expect: Fail closed, alert, and treat absent constraint as undefined.

cases.input: Grant principalKind is person and principalRef points to WM-PER-001.
cases.expect: Reject direct person principal; require account or role.

cases.input: One of three enforcement nodes misses revocation and propagation is marked complete.
cases.expect: Mark partial non-success with deadline, cause and audit correlation.

cases.input: Parent grants read/update for 30 days. Child cites attenuationProofRef P, grants read on one dataset for 7 days, depth 1, subdelegation false.
cases.expect: Accept the child as an attenuated delegated grant.
